title: Seitan from Flour: Recreating a Viral TikTok Vegan Chicken (Goodful)
summary: Goodful’s 6-minute-26-second video follows Merle as she attempts a viral TikTok vegan-chicken hack by transforming flour and water into seitan. The transcript documents forming a dough from 400 g flour and 1 cup water, kneading until gluten develops, and resting. It then details a classic gluten-washing process to separate gluten from starch, collecting starchy water for other recipes (e.g., cold skin noodles) and repeating until the water clears. The gluten ball is seasoned and kneaded, rested again, and finally twisted into knots or shapes. It’s pan-fried, then simmered in vegetable broth with a splash of soy sauce for flavor, before being shredded to resemble chicken in texture. The video emphasizes texture over exact chicken flavor and encourages flavor customization (e.g., using buffalo sauce). The host acknowledges the TikTok inspiration (Future Lettuce) and notes the method yields a chewy, meat-like texture, with the option to modify spices and finishing sauces. Publication details from the source metadata confirm the video’s release date and channel (Goodful).
